full_test_surface.calibration: frozen full eligible calibration pool; no class-stratum recalibration
full_test_surface.oracle: task-level rationale-first oracle calibrated on all 4935 eligible calibration molecules
full_test_surface.perturbation: recorded zero-feature replacement versus one frozen equal-size random mask

matched_target_surface.run_identity: independent V8 fresh-attribution rerun on the frozen A5 identities and checkpoint; not a new independent molecule sample
matched_target_surface.sample: A5 rings-count GIN seed-42 cache identities; 100 eligible calibration and 100 eligible test molecules
matched_target_surface.calibration: each method-target is calibrated once on all 100 calibration molecules at alpha 0.10; fractions frozen before test stratification
matched_target_surface.oracle: method-target-specific selected-count-schedule oracle, calibrated once on the same 100 calibration molecules
matched_target_surface.perturbation: zero-feature replacement versus 20 deterministic equal-size random masks per molecule

negative_result_policy: retain all positive, null, adverse and contradictory strata
boundaries: descriptive conditional audit; no within-stratum CRC guarantee, population inference, chemical edit, causal importance or new independent confirmation
